authored_by: build session (Opus), by hand, before any digest was generated
conclusions: Redis was decided on as the caching layer, on the basis of TTL eviction, in-memory speed, and LRU/LFU eviction policies.
JSON was recommended for serialising cached objects rather than Python pickle, for safety.
The cache-aside pattern was recommended: read, on miss fetch from the database and write to Redis with a TTL; on write, invalidate or update the entry.
The conversation moved on to monitoring but reached no decision there: deployment scale, budget, alerting needs and Redis-specific dashboards were all raised as open questions and left unanswered.
